question: What risks are reported for clip matrix optimizers, and what mitigation is supported?
expected_answer_points: gradient clipping can hide matrix optimizer divergence

candidate_papers.title: Clip matrix optimizer divergence risks
candidate_papers.text: Clip matrix optimizers can hide divergence when gradient clipping masks rapidly rotating eigenspaces. The risk is silent loss drift.

candidate_papers.title: Curvature audits for clipped optimizers
candidate_papers.text: Curvature audits mitigate clip matrix optimizer risk by checking eigenspace drift after clipped updates.

candidate_papers.title: Tokenizer normalization note
candidate_papers.text: Tokenizer normalization improves string matching but contains no matrix optimizer mitigation evidence.

candidate_papers.title: Matrix rendering pipeline
candidate_papers.text: A graphics pipeline accelerates matrix rendering. It does not discuss optimizer clipping or curvature audits.
